en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_cherrystone: The Outlaws enter the Cherrystone Kingdom, where they are met by their furry nemesis.
A group of Mages protect the wondrous treasures that fill the Celandine Vault.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_felheim01: Wulfar, Errol and Orla reach the Felheim Fort. But can they outsmart Ragna?
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_felheim02: Fleeing the Felheim battlefield, the Outlaws need to escape their pursuers.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_floran01: The dense Floran forests present a foggy challenge.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_floran02: At the heavily protected Reserves, the arrival of the Outlaws has been anticipated by the Floran Commanders.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_heavensong0: Errol and Orla decide to find a way to sneak past the Heavensong forces.
The Heavensong Palace presents unique challenges designed by the Prince of Heavensong himself.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_lostleagues: The ransom has been payed, and it's time for Vesper to return Enid. But the rendezvous doesn't go to plan...
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapdescription_tutorial: The Outlaw Chief treats his two children to their first battle.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_cherrystone01: Release all the prisoners and either defeat Caesar or destroy his Stronghold.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_cherrystone02: Have Wulfar or the Twins grab the treasure.
Get Wulfar and the Twins to the escape boat.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_felheim01: Wulfar must attack the main entrance as a diversion while the Twins steal the treasure inside.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_felheim01_upd: Get Wulfar and the Twins to their respective escape zones.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_felheim02: Get Wulfar and the Twins to the escape zone.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_floran02: Wulfar and the Twins must clear the vines protecting the treasure by destroying both enemy Strongholds.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_floran02_upda: Have Wulfar or the Twins grab the treasure.
Get Wulfar and the Twins to the escape boats.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_heavensong01: Find a way to breach the walls, then destroy the enemy Stronghold or defeat Ryota.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_heavensong02: Wulfar must keep Tenri busy while the Twins grab the treasure.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_heavensong02_: Have Wulfar or the Twins grab the treasure.
Get to the lever and open the exit.
Get Wulfar and the Twins to the boats.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_lostleagues: Keep all the Commanders alive and defeat Vesper.
en-GB.dlc1_campaign_mapobjective_tutorial: Wulfar teaches the kids some tricks.
en-GB.dlc_campaign_description: Follow the Outlaw Chief and his two children on a heist-filled adventure!
